from openpyxl import load_workbook
from pathlib import Path

input_path = Path('/mnt/data/spreadsheet/139-16/1_139-16_input.xlsx')
output_path = Path('/mnt/data/outputs/139-16_0_0ad56cf7/1_139-16_output.xlsx')

wb = load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb['Import Data']

term = 'Intagible Assets'

# The permitted edit range is A13:C14. To keep all edits within that range,
# apply the requested "move up from the row below" only where both the target
# cell and source cell in Column C are inside A13:C14: row 13 -> row 14.
r = 13
a_val = ws.cell(row=r, column=1).value
c_val = ws.cell(row=r, column=3).value

def is_empty(v):
    return v is None or (isinstance(v, str) and v.strip() == "")

if a_val is not None and term in str(a_val) and is_empty(c_val):
    ws.cell(row=r, column=3).value = ws.cell(row=r + 1, column=3).value
    ws.cell(row=r + 1, column=3).value = None

output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
print(f"Saved to {output_path}")
